definitions.gloss: (not) at all; entirely; completely (always with negative)
definitions.explanation: An emphatic adverb used exclusively with negative expressions to stress total absence, inability, or incomprehension. Similar to 'not at all' or 'not in the least' in English.

examples.japanese: {皆目|かいもく}⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
{皆目|かいもく}⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{皆目|かいもく}⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかなかった。
examples.english: I had absolutely no idea what he was thinking.

notes:
An adverb that always appears with a negative predicate to emphasize completeness — 'not at all,' 'not in the least.' It is never used in affirmative sentences. The word has a somewhat literary or dramatic flavor.

USAGE:
Most commonly paired with ⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (don't understand) or ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない (have no idea). Adds strong emphasis to the speaker's total lack of understanding or knowledge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皆目|かいもく}⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ — have absolutely no idea
- {皆目|かいもく}⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない — haven't the faintest clue
- {皆目|かいもく}⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧ — don't know at all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧ — not at all (with negative); more casual and colloquial
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧ — not at all; the most common everyday equivalent
- ⟦{一向|いっこう}→一向：20257_ikkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — not at all, not in the least; similar literary register
